question: By what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
To find the percentage by which the cost per kg of gain in T1 was lower than in the control group, we need to calculate the cost per kg of gain in both groups. 

Cost per kg of gain in T1 = 169.94
Cost per kg of gain in control group = 210

Percentage difference = ((210 - 169.94) / 210) * 100
Percentage difference = (40.06 / 210) * 100
Percentage difference = 0.191 or 19.1%

So, the cost per kg of gain in T1 was 19.1% lower than in the control group.
